ops.title: bluebubbles VM chronic ~170% host CPU peg
ops.premise: The bluebubbles guest's host-side Virtualization process (pid 2161) pegs ~167% CPU chronically (780 CPU-hours over 18.7 days ≈ 1.7 cores since boot) because coreaudiod and audiomxd retry-loop XPC lookups against com.apple.BTAudioHALPlugin.xpc / com.apple.bluetooth.xpc — services absent because debloat.bluebubbles disables com.apple.bluetoothd — and launchd (70% in-guest) burns servicing the failed lookups and log flood.

ops.text: launchd pid 1 at 70% and coreaudiod at ~40% in-guest; log shows ~300 failed BTAudioHALPlugin.xpc/bluetooth.xpc lookups per 3 minutes from coreaudiod[54895] and audiomxd[284]
com.apple.bluetoothd is in debloat.bluebubbles (machines.json:341), copied verbatim by scripts/bluebubbles-setup.sh
